title: Ordered join slice
statement: For a simplicial map $p:K\to C$ of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], using the ordered join of [def-coef-ordered-join], define the ordered join slice $C_{/p}$ degreewise by $(C_{/p})_n=\{\sigma:\Delta^n\star K\to C\mid \sigma|_K=p\}$, with operators given by precomposition with $\Delta(\alpha)\star\operatorname{id}_K$.
